_comment: HAND-AUTHORED. uisheet.json beside this is GENERATED by the packer and is rewritten in
full on every repack - nothing may be added there. This file says what the sprites MEAN,
which is the part no packer can know: which sprite is the window frame, where its
nine-slice cuts fall, which one a button is drawn from.
Sprites are addressed BY NAME, so repacking is free - positions churn and this does not
care. A RENAMED input file does break it, which is why roles live here rather than being
Slice values are pixels of the source sprite, measured in docs/ui_sprites.md.

button._note: A THREE-slice: top and bottom 0. The sprite is 104 px tall with natural insets of 42 and 40, leaving 22 px of stretchable middle - so drawn shorter than 82 px the vertical clamp takes the middle row away and the two halves of the plank meet. A button's height belongs to the artist; only its width stretches to its label.

close._note: No slice: drawn whole at whatever size is asked for. A close button has no meaningful stretch axis.
